intent: A cafe owner adding cappuccino to the cash register menu
reason: The barista makes it and serves it on the premises, so it goes on the catering line for coffee and coffee-containing drinks. The cappuccino sachets and bottled cappuccinos in the catalog are packaged goods the café doesn't sell.

alternatives_considered.name: Молотый (порошкообразный) кофе

alternatives_considered.why_not: Catch-all for other soft drinks; coffee drinks have their own line.

intent: A coffee shop adding latte to its menu
reason: A latte is espresso and milk made by the barista, which the catering line names directly as a coffee-containing drink. The canned and bottled lattes in the catalog are goods for resale only.

alternatives_considered.name: Безалкогольные напитки, другие (компоты, квас, морс, лимонады и прочее), приготовленные в заведении общественного питания (без использования в процессе приготовления напитков, подлежащей цифровой маркировке)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Other soft drinks; coffee drinks have their own line.

intent: A coffee shop adding americano to its menu
reason: Brewed from espresso on the premises, so it is the same catering coffee-drinks line as every espresso drink. The catalog's other 'Americano' entries are packs of ground coffee, bottled cold coffee and a biscuit brand.

alternatives_considered.name: Молотый (порошкообразный) кофе
alternatives_considered.why_not: Packs of ground coffee (e.g. Jardin Americano Crema) sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Coffee beans sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Холодный кофе
alternatives_considered.why_not: Bottled cold coffee (e.g. Acafela Americano) resold as it is.

intent: A tea house (choyxona) selling a pot of green tea
reason: Tea brewed and served in the choyxona is the catering 'teas' line, whose units even include a teapot ('шт. (чайник)'). The green-tea goods code is for selling loose or packed leaf, not a brewed pot.

alternatives_considered.name: Зеленый чай развесной и упакованный всех видов (заварка)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Dry green tea sold by weight or in packs: what the choyxona buys, not what the guest is served.

alternatives_considered.name: Холодный чай
alternatives_considered.why_not: Factory-bottled iced tea resold as it is.

alternatives_considered.name: Безалкогольные напитки, другие (компоты, квас, морс, лимонады и прочее), приготовленные в заведении общественного питания (без использования в процессе приготовления напитков, подлежащей цифровой маркировке)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Other soft drinks; tea has its own line.

intent: A cafe selling homemade lemonade by the glass or jug
reason: The catering line for other soft drinks names lemonades made in the establishment. It carries one condition: no digitally-marked drink (for example bottled soda water or a branded soft drink) may go into it, and pouring out a bottled lemonade is resale of goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Безалкогольные напитки (газированные и негазированные)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Factory-bottled lemonades (FENSI and others) resold as they are, not a homemade drink.

alternatives_considered.name: Сироп
alternatives_considered.why_not: Lemonade syrup sold as a product; an ingredient, not the drink served.

alternatives_considered.name: Безалкогольные напитки, чаи различные, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Teas line; a lemonade is not tea.

intent: A cafe squeezing fresh orange juice to order
reason: Juice squeezed to order is a soft drink made on site that is neither tea nor coffee, so it takes the 'other soft drinks (compotes, kvass, mors, lemonades and others)' line. Packaged juice poured from a carton would be resale of goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Фруктовые и овощные соки, в т.ч. потока (всех видов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Packaged fruit and vegetable juices sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Сокосодержащие напитки
alternatives_considered.why_not: Factory-made juice drinks resold as they are.

alternatives_considered.name: Десерты, фрукты и орехи, реализуемые (в том числе приготовленные) в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fruit and nut desserts; a juice is a drink, not a dessert.

intent: A cafe blending smoothies to order
reason: A drink blended to order in the café that is neither tea nor coffee, so the catering 'other soft drinks' line. The catalog's 'smoothie' entries are bottled shakes, frozen fruit mixes and hookah flavours.

alternatives_considered.name: Безалкогольные напитки (газированные и негазированные)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Bottled soft drinks, where factory smoothie shakes (e.g. OKF Smoothie Shake) sit; resale of goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Прочие замороженные овощи
alternatives_considered.why_not: Frozen fruit mixes for making smoothies: an ingredient, not the drink.

alternatives_considered.name: Десерты, фрукты и орехи, реализуемые (в том числе приготовленные) в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fruit desserts; a smoothie is served as a drink.

intent: A restaurant or osh markazi selling a portion of plov
reason: Plov cooked and served in the establishment is a main course built around meat, so 'main dishes with meat' is the precise line. 'Main dishes from vegetables, grains and pasta' is also acceptable because rice is the bulk of the dish, and it is the right line for a meatless plov.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, прочие, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: 'Other main dishes' is only for dishes no specific line covers.

alternatives_considered.name: Готовые основные блюда (реализованные в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Ready main dishes sold in shops, not a portion served by a restaurant.

alternatives_considered.name: Приправы
alternatives_considered.why_not: Plov spice mixes; the catalog has no plov-specific dish code.

intent: A restaurant grilling shashlik skewers
reason: Shashlik grilled and served on site is a main course: lamb or beef shashlik takes 'main dishes with meat' and chicken shashlik takes 'main dishes with poultry', so both count for the bare word. The catalog's other 'шашлык' entries are seasonings, crisps and ketchups.

alternatives_considered.name: Закуски, Закуски с мясом, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Meat starters; shashlik is served as a main course.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, с рыбой и морепродуктами, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fish main dishes; fish shashlik exists, but the bare word means meat.

alternatives_considered.name: Готовые основные блюда (реализованные в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Ready main dishes sold in shops.

intent: A tea house baking samsa in a tandoor and selling them by the piece
reason: Samsa is a filled dough pastry baked on site, which is exactly 'main dishes, flour-based' (the Uzbek wording 'xamirli', dough-based, is the traditional class of somsa and manti). 'Fast food' also fits samsa sold as street food, and 'main dishes with meat' is now added because tandir samsa is normally meat-filled, the same reasoning already accepted for manti; the bread line is for non, not filled pastries.

alternatives_considered.name: Хлеб и хлебные изделия реализуемые (в том числе приготовленные) в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Bread and bread products (Uzbek 'non va non mahsulotlari'); samsa is a filled pastry, not bread.

alternatives_considered.name: Фаст-фуд (реализованный в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fast food sold in shops, not a tea house baking it.

alternatives_considered.name: Полуфабрикаты мучных изделий (всех видов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Semi-finished dough products such as samsa dough, sold as goods.

intent: A cafe adding lagman to its menu
reason: Plain lagman served with broth is a first course, so 'soups' is the best default, but fried or thick lagman is a main dish and the bare word cannot tell them apart. Among main-dish lines, meat, pasta/noodles and flour-based all describe it; 'flour-based' is now added because its Uzbek wording 'xamirli' (dough dishes) is how Uzbek cooking classes lag'mon.

alternatives_considered.name: Фаст-фуд, приготовленный в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fast food; lagman is a plated dish, not a fast-food item.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, прочие, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Other main dishes; specific lines cover it.

alternatives_considered.name: Макароны упакованные
alternatives_considered.why_not: Packaged pasta, including lagman noodles sold as goods.

intent: A restaurant selling steamed manti
reason: Manti are steamed dough dumplings made on site, which is exactly 'main dishes, flour-based' (Uzbek 'xamirli', dough-based). 'Main dishes with meat' is also acceptable because the standard filling is meat.

alternatives_considered.name: Полуфабрикаты мучных изделий (всех видов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Frozen manti and other semi-finished dough products sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Фаст-фуд, приготовленный в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fast food; steamed manti are served as a plated main course.

alternatives_considered.name: Готовые основные блюда (реализованные в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Ready main dishes sold in shops.

intent: A fast-food stall selling shawarma
reason: Shawarma assembled and sold at the stall is exactly the catering 'fast food' line. A shop reselling ready-made shawarma would use the retail fast-food code instead.

alternatives_considered.name: Фаст-фуд (реализованный в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fast food sold in retail outlets: for a shop reselling ready shawarma, not a stall making it.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, с птицей, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания

alternatives_considered.name: Готовые или консервированные продукты из говядины
alternatives_considered.why_not: Ready or canned meat products, where frozen doner meat sits; an ingredient sold as goods.

intent: A fast-food kiosk selling hot dogs
reason: A hot dog assembled on site is the catering 'fast food' line. The catalog's 'hot dog' entries are buns, sausages and sauces sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Фаст-фуд (реализованный в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fast food sold in shops.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Sausages sold as goods; an ingredient.

alternatives_considered.name: Полуфабрикаты мучных изделий (всех видов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Hot-dog buns and other semi-finished flour products sold as goods.

intent: A pizzeria selling a pepperoni pizza
reason: Pizza from a pizzeria is usually treated as catering 'fast food'. 'Main dishes, flour-based' is equally defensible, especially in a sit-down restaurant, because pizza is a dough dish.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, с мясом, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Meat main dishes; pepperoni is a topping, the dish is defined by its dough.

alternatives_considered.name: Фаст-фуд (реализованный в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Retail fast food, for shops reselling pizza.

alternatives_considered.name: Полуфабрикаты мучных изделий (всех видов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Frozen pizza dough and other semi-finished products sold as goods.

intent: A sushi bar selling a Philadelphia roll set
reason: A set of salmon rolls made in a sushi bar is a fish dish, so 'main dishes with fish and seafood' is the best line. 'Snacks with fish and seafood' is also acceptable when rolls are served as a starter.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, из овощей, круп и макаронных изделий, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Grain dishes; rice is the base, but the salmon defines the roll.

alternatives_considered.name: Комплексные рационы питания, обеды (в том числе на торжественных меоприятиях), приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Set lunches; a roll set is not a fixed lunch ration.

alternatives_considered.name: Готовые основные блюда (реализованные в торговых точках)

intent: A restaurant adding Caesar salad to the menu
reason: The catering class has a dedicated line for salads prepared in the establishment, and Caesar is a salad whatever chicken it carries. Deli salads sold in shops use the retail salads code.

alternatives_considered.name: Салаты (реализованный в торговых точках)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Salads sold in retail outlets.

alternatives_considered.name: Закуски, Закуски с птицей, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Poultry starters; the salads line is exact.

alternatives_considered.name: Соус

intent: A canteen selling a bowl of borscht
reason: Borscht cooked in the canteen is the catering 'soups' line. The catalog's other 'борщ' entries are seasonings and dry soup mixes sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Soup and broth mixes (e.g. a dry borscht mix) sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Приправы

intent: A cafe selling cake by the slice
reason: The catering line 'desserts, confectionery, sold (including prepared) in the establishment' covers cake served by the slice, even when the cake is bought in from a bakery. A whole factory cake sold in its box would be the goods code.

alternatives_considered.name: Мучные кондитерские изделия и пирожные (всех видов)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Flour confectionery and cakes sold as goods.

alternatives_considered.name: Десерты, прочие, реализуемые (в том числе приготовленные) в заведении общественного питания

alternatives_considered.why_not: Bread line; cake is not bread.

intent: A cafe serving scoops of ice cream in a bowl
reason: Scooped and served as a dessert in the café, so a catering dessert line. Ice cream is not confectionery in the catalog's own goods structure, so 'desserts, other' fits best, but 'desserts, confectionery' is a common and defensible choice; a wrapped ice cream sold from the freezer would be the packaged ice-cream goods code.

alternatives_considered.name: Мороженое упакованное
alternatives_considered.why_not: Packaged ice cream resold as it is.

alternatives_considered.name: Десерты, фрукты и орехи, реализуемые (в том числе приготовленные) в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Fruit and nut desserts; ice cream is not a fruit dish.

alternatives_considered.name: Гарниры, соусы и добавки (топинги), приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Toppings line; a scoop served as a dessert is the dessert itself.

intent: A restaurant selling a fixed-price business lunch set
reason: A fixed-price set at lunchtime is exactly the catering line 'complex meal rations, lunches'. Ringing each dish separately would use the dish lines instead.

alternatives_considered.name: Комплексные рационы питания, ужины (в том числе на торжественных меоприятиях), приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Set dinners.

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, с мясом, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: A single meat main dish, not a set.

alternatives_considered.name: Лапша быстрого приготовления
alternatives_considered.why_not: Instant noodles, one brand of which is called 'Бизнес-Ланч'; a packaged product.

intent: A cafe selling a set breakfast

alternatives_considered.name: Основные блюда, из яиц, приготовленные в заведении общественного питания
alternatives_considered.why_not: Egg main dishes, for a single dish rather than a set.

alternatives_considered.name: Комплексные рационы питания, обеды (в том числе на торжественных меоприятиях), приготовленные в заведении общественного питания

alternatives_considered.name: Готовые пищевые продукты, из зерна и злаков
alternatives_considered.why_not: Ready cereal products such as breakfast granola, sold as goods.

intent: A restaurant adding a delivery charge line for its own food to the receipt
reason: The catering line 'other services, delivery of food prepared in the establishment' is exactly a restaurant's delivery charge. The general 'food delivery service' code describes the same service and is defensible, though it is meant for courier and delivery companies.

alternatives_considered.name: Курьерская услуга
alternatives_considered.why_not: Generic courier service; less specific than either food-delivery code.

alternatives_considered.name: Посуда для доставки и на вынос, пластиковый контейнер для еды из заведения общественного питания

alternatives_considered.name: Служба доставки товаров

alternatives_considered.name: Кальян (прибор)

alternatives_considered.why_not: Renting a table or room; the charge is for the prepared hookah.

alternatives_considered.name: Ассорти из сухофруктов

intent: A choyxona selling a pot of green tea
reason: Green tea brewed and served in the choyxona is the catering 'teas' line. The Uzbek catalog's top 'ko'k choy' hit is dry leaf tea sold by weight or in packs, which is goods.
